project_type: Nx monorepo with Angular frontend, Lambda backend, CDK infrastructure
build_system: Nx 23.1 with pnpm. The api project build target runs `tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit` for type checking. CDK bundles Lambda via esbuild (NodejsFunction with entry property).
test_framework: No test files currently exist for the API
build_command: source /opt/env_var.sh && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use 24 && cd /projects/sandbox/recipe-manager && pnpm install && pnpm nx build api
test_command: No tests exist for api project. Verify with TypeScript type checking: pnpm nx build api
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm install to install dependencies. 2. Run pnpm nx build api to type-check the API. 3. Run pnpm nx build infra to type-check the CDK stack. 4. Run pnpm nx lint api to lint the API code.
setup_instructions: source /opt/env_var.sh && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use 24 && cd /projects/sandbox/recipe-manager && pnpm install
environment_constraints: Node.js 24.18.0 available (project requires 26 but 24 is sufficient for type-checking). pnpm 11.1.2 available via NVM. Network access to npmjs.org confirmed. No Docker daemon available.
contribution_requirements: PR title must be semantic (e.g., 'refactor: split monolithic lambda handler'). TypeScript strict mode with noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature - must use bracket notation for index signatures. Use NodejsFunction with entry property in CDK. CORS headers on every response.
key_patterns: Single DynamoDB table with userId PK + id SK. byEntityType GSI for queries. User identity from event.requestContext.authorizer.claims.sub. Response helper function wraps status + CORS headers. Bedrock client for AI operations. HTML stripping for URL import. Large prompt templates with English/German examples.
directory_structure: apps/api/src/ - Lambda handler source (currently single file). apps/infra/src/stacks/ - CDK stack. apps/web/ - Angular frontend. libs/shared/src/ - Shared TypeScript types. tsconfig.base.json defines @recipe-manager/shared path alias.
